answer: Each key must keep a public work endpoint open, and anonymous mystery shoppers send it ordinary paid requests at random hours, indistinguishable from customer jobs. Their quality is compared with the key's graded epoch answers. A farm that props up hundreds of keys with one polished showcase answer and a cheap stub behind it is exposed: the key that wrote a fine sonnet for graders returns a fable-thin reply to a shopper asking about a tidal inlet. Big gaps freeze payouts, so every key must carry real capacity all day.
